# incident.io — account brief

## Who

incident.io describes itself as "All-in-one incident management — Declare, run, and learn from incidents without leaving Slack. Incident management for teams that ship software." ([source](https://incident.io/)). Its GitHub org profile is listed as incident.io and links incident.io as its website ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in incident-io/on-call-app ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/eas.json)).
- The app's package.json pins react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- incident-io/on-call-app was last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)).
- The org has 38 public repos and 520 followers ([source](https://github.com/incident-io)).
- incident.io On-call has 3,100 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)) and 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)).
- An open issue reads "EAS build failing on iOS since Xcode 16 image update" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)).
- An open issue reads "Track: upgrade to Expo SDK 53" ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).
- incident.io is hiring a "Product Engineer, Mobile (React Native)" in London or Remote (UK) ([source](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=45311640)).

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@incident-io-maintainer-1), 174 commits, top contributor to incident-io/on-call-app ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company incident.io, location Remote, website https://incident.io, and bio "Mobile engineer at incident.io. Maintains the incident.io On-call app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)).
- Maintainer Two (@incident-io-maintainer-2), 92 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company incident.io, location New York, NY, website https://incident.io, and bio "React Native developer on the incident.io mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the incident.io On-call app." ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-2)).
- Maintainer Three (@incident-io-maintainer-3), 45 commits ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3)). Profile lists company incident.io, location San Francisco, CA, website https://incident.io, and bio "Engineer at incident.io. Mostly the incident.io On-call app, sometimes the API." ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-3)).

## Why now

The repo was last pushed 2026-08-19 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app)) and the app shipped 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). It is on react-native 0.74.3 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/blob/main/package.json)) with an open issue tracking an upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer One — your profile says you maintain the incident.io On-call app on Expo / React Native ([source](https://github.com/incident-io-maintainer-1)), and the repo has an open issue for an EAS build failing on iOS since the Xcode 16 image update ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/214)). There is also an open issue tracking the upgrade to Expo SDK 53 ([source](https://github.com/incident-io/on-call-app/issues/198)), alongside 5 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/incident-io/id1585204777)). How are you sequencing that SDK 53 upgrade against the iOS build failure without stalling your release cadence?
